mi-macomb-2026-circuit-noninc-spagnuolo-.name: James L. Spagnuolo
mi-macomb-2026-circuit-noninc-spagnuolo-.bio: Trial lawyer practicing since 2002, founder of Macomb Law Group, mediator, and U.S. Marine Corps veteran.

positions.stance: "A judge's job is not to make law. It's to apply it—faithfully and fairly," guided by the Constitution, statutes, and binding precedent, "not politics."
"Apply the law fairly and consistently"; says every person deserves equal treatment and the same rules in the same courtroom.
"Maintain discipline and order. Respect is required for everyone in the courtroom."
"Listen before ruling. People must feel heard, even when the outcome is difficult."
"Follow precedent," saying stability and predictability are essential for families, workers, and businesses.

mi-macomb-2026-circuit-noninc-taylor-gen.name: Genevieve L. Taylor
mi-macomb-2026-circuit-noninc-taylor-gen.bio: Magistrate and attorney with nearly two decades of legal practice; elected school board trustee.

positions.stance: "Upholding the highest standards of the court with unwavering ethics and complete transparency in every decision."
"Ensuring that every individual, regardless of background, receives fair treatment and an impartial hearing under the law."
Describes "a lifetime dedicated to public service, bringing deep legal expertise and a balanced perspective to the bench."

mi-oakland-2026-app2-inc-trebilcock-chri.name: Christopher M. Trebilcock
mi-oakland-2026-app2-inc-trebilcock-chri.bio: Michigan Court of Appeals judge appointed in 2025; former attorney at Clark Hill and Miller Canfield and former U.S. Department of Labor attorney-advisor.

mi-oakland-2026-circuit-noninc-king-vict.name: Victoria King
mi-oakland-2026-circuit-noninc-king-vict.bio: Judicial staff attorney for 14 years advising Oakland County Circuit Court judges; licensed attorney for almost two decades.

mi-oakland-2026-circuit-noninc-neilson-l.name: Lisa Marie Neilson
mi-oakland-2026-circuit-noninc-neilson-l.bio: Former Family Court judge (2012-2022) and attorney with more than two decades in family and probate law; mediator and arbitrator.

mi-oakland-2026-probate-noninc-dery-elis.name: Elisabeth Dery
mi-oakland-2026-probate-noninc-dery-elis.bio: Probate attorney for nearly 15 years; former emergency veterinary technician.

mi-oakland-2026-probate-noninc-hallmark-.name: Jessica Ann Hallmark
mi-oakland-2026-probate-noninc-hallmark-.bio: Attorney with nearly two decades of legal practice.

wa-pierce-2026-district-court-pos4-horib.name: Neil Horibe
wa-pierce-2026-district-court-pos4-horib.bio: Industrial Appeals Judge at the Washington State Board of Industrial Insurance Appeals, Pierce County District Court judge pro tem, and former deputy prosecuting attorney.

wa-pierce-2026-district-court-pos7-nogue.name: Pam Nogueira
wa-pierce-2026-district-court-pos7-nogue.bio: Attorney for 11 years who has served as a pro tem judge, court commissioner, and judge.

wa-pierce-2026-district-court-pos7-somme.name: Mike Sommerfeld
wa-pierce-2026-district-court-pos7-somme.bio: Pierce County Deputy Prosecuting Attorney since 1995 and former Thurston County District Court judge pro tem.

wa-pierce-2026-district-court-pos8-nelso.name: Sven Nelson
wa-pierce-2026-district-court-pos8-nelso.bio: Pierce County Deputy Prosecuting Attorney since 1996 and judge pro tem for the past seven years.
